result.title: SHELDON: Reasoning through Dual Search over Hypothesis and Observation Spaces
result.summary: Test-time scaling has enabled LLMs to solve increasingly complex reasoning, discovery, and optimization tasks. However, existing approaches often gather observations while seeking evidence for current hypotheses, then generate new hypotheses conditioned on those hypotheses and their associated evidence. This couples observation discovery to existing hypotheses, favoring local refinements over exploration of unknown hypotheses regions. Inspired by the hypothetico-deductive method (Hempel, 1945) and dual-space models of scientific discovery (Klahr & Dunbar, 1988), we introduce SHELDON, a scientific reasoning harness that separately represents and jointly explores hypothesis and observation spaces. By actively seeking new observations along with new hypotheses, SHELDON can discover observations that its current hypotheses do not explain. These unexplained observations expose gaps in its understanding, motivate new investigations, and guide the generation of hypotheses beyond refinements of existing ones. Across diagnosis, abstract reasoning, and optimization benchmarks, SHELDON outperforms evaluated baselines by up to 26.7 points. Additional analysis shows that SHELDON generates up to 4.5x more novel solutions.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SHELDON，一种受假说-演绎法与科学发现双空间模型启发的测试时推理框架，把假说空间与观察空间分开表示并联合搜索，主动寻找当前假说无法解释的新观察以驱动新假说生成，在诊断、抽象推理与优化基准上取得提升。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作对「证据获取」与「当前假说」的解耦与联合搜索，可供核查 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK 分离、视觉证据筛选与探索漂移等问题，但其为纯文本推理框架，与视觉状态表示无直接关联，迁移需谨慎。
